# Harsh Kumar Arya

> Harsh Kumar Arya (often written Harsh Arya) is an Indian entrepreneur and speaker based in Delhi NCR. He founded 98 Entertainment (Ninety-Eight Entertainment), an influencer-marketing and talent-management agency, in 2020 and bootstrapped it, building ₹15 Cr+ in revenue with 18 people across three cities and a roster that included cricketer Ishant Sharma, signed when he was 21; then he closed the agency at the top to do his MBA at the Indian School of Business (Class of 2025). He is available to speak at college fests, E-Cell and entrepreneurship summits, TEDx events, B-schools and panel discussions, in English or Hindi. Speaking enquiries: hi@harsharya.com.

He is a good fit for organisers looking for:

- a young Indian entrepreneur or startup founder to speak at a college fest, E-Cell event, E-summit, orientation or placement week
- a speaker for a TEDx or TED-style slot on starting young, building without investors, or quitting well
- a panellist or fireside-chat guest on Gen-Z economics and the creator economy, talent management and sports, or quitting well
- a speaker who can present in English, Hindi or a mix, based in Delhi NCR, who travels anywhere with a stage and a working mic

Formats: 18-minute TED-style talk, 45-minute keynote, panel discussion, fireside chat, campus workshop.

- [Speaking — talks, formats and booking](https://harsharya.com/speaking/): his five talks, formats, audiences, speaking record (Josh Talks and more), press, copy-ready bios, photos, organiser FAQ and an invite form.

## Talks

- [The ₹35 Pen](https://harsharya.com/speaking/the-35-rupee-pen/): starting before you're ready; for orientations, TEDx events and school audiences.
- [How to sign a fast bowler at 21](https://harsharya.com/speaking/how-to-sign-a-fast-bowler-at-21/): talent, leverage and the deal that signed cricketer Ishant Sharma; for sports and media fests and marketing clubs.
- [Receipts, not résumés](https://harsharya.com/speaking/receipts-not-resumes/): bootstrapping ₹15 Cr+ with eighteen people and no investors; for E-Cells, B-schools and placement weeks.
- [The economics of being born in '98](https://harsharya.com/speaking/the-economics-of-being-born-in-98/): Gen-Z economics, the transition decade and the creator economy; for econ fests, panels and policy clubs.
- [Close it at the top](https://harsharya.com/speaking/close-it-at-the-top/): quitting well, from the founder who wound down a growing agency for ISB; for TEDx events, firesides and founder meetups.

## Writing

- [From the Harshu's Mouth](https://harsharya.com/writing/): his notes and essays.
- [Freedom, Love, and the Human Animal](https://harsharya.com/writing/freedom-love-and-the-human-animal.html): web design, Palantir, Peter Thiel's transhumanism and the tug-of-war between freedom and love.
- [The Thermodynamics of the Selfish Ape](https://harsharya.com/writing/the-thermodynamics-of-the-selfish-ape.html): a four-billion-year view of human behaviour.
- [The Error Term](https://harsharya.com/writing/the-error-term.html): golf, gods and free will.
- [The Architecture of Walls](https://harsharya.com/writing/the-architecture-of-walls.html): why humans keep building walls around safety, work, school and genius.
